Why it holds up

Not a toy.

Three things that separate a demo from something you can stand behind.

🔒
Secure by design
The AI never gets a shell on your machine. It returns data; trusted code does the rest. Enterprise-safe isolation.
✨
Designed, not slop
A built-in quality floor means every app looks intentional — a branded design system, not generic AI output.
📱
Real native output
A genuine native iOS app, running on a real device in under an hour — not a web mock-up or a screenshot.
